scope.default: Keep the native session utilities outlet available before the first turn; title, actions, tabs and single corner semantics are unchanged; a read-only title seat may replace breadcrumb text, falling back to the original native title
scope.boundary: Only the official client renderer is patched. Registered utilities retain their own session, content and authorization conditions; blank rows right-align utilities next to the preserved native corner; the title seat only changes displayed text and preserves navigation, lineage, actions and the durable title log
limitations: All existing session utilities may render for a blank session; no provider or authorization is synthesized
A sessionless header remains governed by the official ConversationHeader owner boundary
scope.patchContext: Zero-context hunks; the explicit UI spec enables --unidiff-zero only after full before-SHA verification, with exact after-SHA verification.
